verdict.rationale: 1Password's own support docs say users can open 1Password on Apple Watch to look up one-time passwords, which directly delivers reading codes from a smartwatch instead of the phone. missing for 10: evidence for smartwatches other than Apple Watch (e.g., Wear OS), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the watch OTP experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: Use 1Password on your Apple Watch to quickly look up information: credit card numbers and PINs, one-time passwords
